Video. A Russian overnight attack on Kyiv, Ukraine, killed eight people on Friday 20 November 2026, according to Associated Press, leaving buildings and warehouses damaged across the capital. Firefighters battled blazes as emergency crews searched the wreckage and police collected evidence.
